name: Scientific Figure Making
summary: Publication-ready matplotlib figures for academic papers, slides, and reports in the figures4papers house style: grouped bars, trend lines, scatter, heatmaps, and multi-panel layouts, with print/vector export conventions (PDF/SVG/high-DPI) and parity with the figures4papers demo projects. Loads references progressively instead of up front. Use when finalizing or creating publication figures in matplotlib; not for interactive dashboards, web viz (Plotly/Altair/Bokeh), exploratory-only plots, dominant 3D or geographic mapping, or Illustrator/Figma-first infographics. Carried verbatim from ChenLiu-1996/figures4papers at the pinned commit; only the skill directory (SKILL.md plus references) is carried, not the figure_* demo projects. Licensed CC BY-NC 4.0: non-commercial use only, attribution required.

summaryI18n.zh-CN: 面向学术论文、幻灯片与报告的出版级 matplotlib 图表技能，采用 figures4papers 的固定风格：分组柱状图、趋势线、散点图、热力图与多面板布局，附带打印/矢量导出规范（PDF/SVG/高 DPI），并与 figures4papers 示例项目保持一致。参考文件按需渐进加载，而非一次性全部载入。在用 matplotlib 制作或定稿出版图表时使用；不适用于交互式仪表盘、网页可视化（Plotly/Altair/Bokeh）、纯探索性绘图、以 3D 或地理制图为主的工作流，或 Illustrator/Figma 优先的信息图。自 ChenLiu-1996/figures4papers 钉住 commit 逐字携带，仅携带技能目录（SKILL.md 与 references），不含 figure_* 示例项目。许可证为 CC BY-NC 4.0：仅限非商业使用，需署名。
